title: 晶片邊緣耦合器設計
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入邊緣耦合模場展開、端面反射與對準；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine edge-coupler mode expansion, facet reflection and alignment. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。高斯重疊只是近似；實際向量模態、端面角度、空隙與偏振需用完整場解或量測驗證。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Gaussian overlap is approximate; vector modes, facet angle, gaps and polarization need field simulation or measurement.

stages.descriptionEn: Address modes and expansion through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 比較晶片與光纖模場

steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for compare chip and fiber modes: Mode-size mismatch limits coupling despite aligned centers.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。畫同功率正規化的兩模場。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
